cards.mood: The piece opens with an ethereal, cinematic atmosphere that quickly erupts into a high-energy, triumphant drive.
cards.palette: Heavily distorted electric guitars playing palm-muted rhythmic chugs in the verses and soaring, harmonized lead melodies in the choruses serve as the core harmonic and melodic drivers throughout the track.

cards.mood: The piece opens with a cinematic and anticipatory atmosphere, establishing a sense of vastness before erupting into high-octane aggression and triumph.
